musical_family: music in a rap or hip-hop style
dance music made with electronic instruments
music in a jazz or soul style
production_texture: a gritty noisy distorted sound texture
a soft blurred sample-based sound texture
rhythmic_behavior: an active rhythm with offbeat accents
free flowing music without a steady beat
music with no regular rhythmic pulse
vocal_delivery: rhythmically spoken or rapped lead vocals
a lead voice rapping or speaking in rhythm
a lead singer singing a melody
instruments playing without a human voice
wordless voices or chopped voice samples

decision: PROMISING_ZERO_SHOT_SIGNAL if any axis meets every gate in both paraphrases and exact-D sensitivity, lower AUC interval >.5, neighbor AUC>.5, and diagnostic-artist-excluded AUC>.5; otherwise ZERO_SHOT_NOT_ESTABLISHED. Neither outcome validates causal mismatch taxonomy without independent annotations.
exclusions: no fitting, prompt selection, new models, audio inference, new ratings, production activation, or per-song rules; structure/harmony deferred because reliable direct measurement unavailable in this small probe study
manual_annotation: no new annotations; preserve six existing notes as qualitative development evidence only
neighbor_slice: either endpoint in exact ArmD top10 of other, excluding self; ties by track ID
pair_continuous: Jensen-Shannon divergence of prompt-mean softmax profiles, divided by log(2)
pair_flag: both tracks reliable and top concepts differ; otherwise explicit abstention
primary_audio: mean normalized full-song Stage5G1 segment vectors, without renormalizing the mean; mean cosine logits
primary_labels: frozen Stage5E3 PLAYLIST_COMPATIBILITY_V1 labels only; 1-2 bad, 4-5 good, 3 ambiguous
probabilities: softmax over each non-exhaustive prompt vocabulary; relative probe weights, not calibrated class probabilities
reliability: both paraphrases choose the same top concept and each top-minus-second cosine margin >=.02
sensitivity_audio: mean exact Arm-D four normalized view vectors, same mean cosine logits
uncertainty: 2000 paired anchor bootstrap draws; per-axis 98.75% percentile intervals (four-axis Bonferroni); union descriptive 95%
